newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 rupees up at 41.90 to the dollar on Sunday in the kerb market amid dollar profit-taking, dealers said.
They said despite high supply of dollars, the rupee was expected to remain stable as low dollar rates could attract some buying on Monday.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.80 percent, down from Saturday's close at 4.90 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
